g.text: Single host | SD 1.5 | 100-1,000 images | explicit CPU test backend
Physical GPU slots on one host
One stage per physical GPU UUID
READY: calibrated policy + load test passed
API and supervisor are separate processes; all persistent volumes are host-local.
GPU cycle: EVALUATE, TRAIN, CAPTION, TRAIN; owner round-robin within each class.
CPU fake slots are test-only and never map multiple slots to one real GPU.
No calibrated policy: COMPLETED_UNVERIFIED, never an implied quality guarantee.
Multi-host failover and automatic quality remediation are deferred; see trade-offs.
